title: P18-B business portfolio — owner-scoped projection over canonical objective_relation
description: P18-B: ObjectivePortfolioService.businessPortfolio — READ-ONLY advisory projection, zero writes reachable. Same owner-scope contract as company cockpit: actor derived from x-operator-id at the edge; only objectives the actor owns in the business are projected (strict scope proof via new ObjectiveAuthorityService.strictEnumerate — persisted-key entityPage enumeration + strict get + payload-identity check, org-wide fail-closed); actor owning none → FAIL_CLOSED_PORTFOLIO_SCOPE (403, code-only). Only proven relations whose BOTH endpoints are owned enter the projection (proven edges are bilaterally owner-scoped; the filter is the honest local check). Per-objective: depends_on/dependents/conflicts/supersedes/superseded_by edge lists (all states, code-unit relation_id order, counterparty_objective_id naming) + dependency summary (ACTIVE upstream → SATISFIED iff upstream ACHIEVED, PENDING non-terminal, FAILED terminal non-ACHIEVED; blocked = pending+failed>0) + active_conflicts. Edges/counts (incl. objectives_dependency_blocked) computed over the FULL scoped set before the 200-objective page (honest totals like cockpit). Route GET /api/vnext/businesses/:id/portfolio — NO read-budget wrap, deliberately identical availability bounds to unbudgeted /company (the scheduler's {1024,512} is calibrated for per-objective reads; org-wide multiplicative charging here would trip at a fraction of bound with no safety gain — every loop is progression-bounded, corrupt rows fail closed loudly). objective-cockpit.businessCompany refactored onto strictEnumerate (same proof, code → FAIL_CLOSED_OBJECTIVE_IDENTITY; UI gloss updated + PORTFOLIO_DISABLED entry). Documented bounds: non-transactional mixed-snapshot (stale-owned render, edges can never leak); advisory only — no admission/scheduling/execution consumer (P18-C consumes upstreamOf/conflictsWith). Codex-only.
